en: Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out
zh: 在 `claude plugin install --json` 结果中新增 `commandPrinted`，当 plugin 的安装命令写入 stderr 时为 true；并新增 `commandFailed`，当该命令以错误退出、被终止或超时时为 true
